# Lawrence Bauda

> Official website and digital portfolio of Lawrence Bauda, a full-stack software developer, founder of ZE Documentation, transport network vehicle service (TNVS) operator, and former global esports finalist based in Manila, Philippines.

## Background & Profile
- [About Me](https://lawrencebauda.com/#about): Professional summary, early programming roots in Bagong Silang, XDA/Power Mac mobile consulting, and esports history (Global Top 26 ROS finalist).

## Selected Projects & Ventures
- [ZE Documentation](https://lawrencebauda.com/#work): Founded in June 2026 to provide registration assistance, LTFRB compliance, and onboarding services for new TNVS operators.
- [IGN: International](https://lawrencebauda.com/#work): Custom MTA:SA multiplayer server architecture and Lua scripting (2015–2018).
- [Stick Run Security Patching](https://lawrencebauda.com/#work): Zero-day exploit discovery and software helper patching (2016–2017).
- [Multi-App Fleet Operations](https://lawrencebauda.com/#work): Logistics and transport execution across Lalamove, Move It, and JoyRide MC Taxis (2022–2025).

## Technical Expertise
- **Frontend & Interfaces:** TypeScript, React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, ExtendScript / Photoshop JSX, Lua (MTA:SA).
- **Backend & Automation:** Node.js, Python, Playwright, Flask, REST APIs.
- **Infrastructure & Tools:** Windows 11 PowerShell, OBS Multi-RTMP streaming, network latency optimization, HWiNFO64 diagnostics.
